name: ZZ Tau IRS

paper.title: Shadowing in the protoplanetary disk of ZZ Tau IRS with HST

notes: Distance adopted as 130.7 pc following Hashimoto et al. 2024 (they reject the Gaia DR3 parallax distance of 105.7 pc due to a poor astrometric solution, RUWE=2.49). HST WFC3 image reveals a dark lane (disk midplane) and shadow-driven brightness asymmetries from a misaligned inner disk; outer disk extends to ~300 au.
